instructions: Nice as it is to have so many convenient, time-saving foods — isn't the real thrill of cooking still in making something that's really yours? And when you can turn those quick-and-easy's into tempting new dishes, with just a little time and work, that's the nicest kind of cooking.

That's the kind of recipes you'll find in this new book. They're short and easy. They call for handy, ready-prepared ingredients . . . canned and frozen foods . . . packaged mixes. They give you the fun of creative cooking, with perfect results . . . deliciously yours.
And the convenient food that helps you most of all is Pet Evaporated Milk...."
